description: Source code implementing signal handling functions for threads in Zephyr RTOS using CMSIS-RTOS API, including setting, clearing, and waiting for signal flags.

methods.name: k_thread_other_custom_data_get
methods.description: Retrieves custom data associated with a thread.

methods.name: osSignalSet
methods.description: Sets specified signal flags for a thread.

methods.name: osSignalClear
methods.description: Clears specified signal flags for a thread.

methods.name: osSignalWait
methods.description: Waits for one or more signal flags to be set for the current thread.
